hubSubtitle: A sovereign AI ecosystem, fine-tuned from a synthesis of Anthropic, OpenAI, and Gemini models. An entire digital civilization, at your command.
welcomeMessage: Welcome to the AfghanAI Hub. The Scriptorium on the left lists available agents. How may I assist you today?
commandBarPlaceholder: Enter your command or use the mic...
heroTitle: The Future of Intelligence, Rooted in Heritage.
heroSubtitle: Welcome to the AfghanAI Hub, a sovereign, living intelligence designed to preserve our past and build our future. Your digital renaissance starts now.
howItWorks1Desc: Select from over 120 specialized AI agents, each an expert in its field, from poetry to quantum physics.
howItWorks2Desc: Interact with your chosen agent using natural language. The Oracle AI will understand your intent and route your command.
howItWorks3Desc: Get intelligent, culturally-aware responses, generated content, or completed tasks in seconds.
pricingSubtitle: Powerful, accessible intelligence for everyone. Start for free, upgrade when you're ready.
featureCognitiveCoreDesc: Leverages a dual-intelligence system: swift "Hafiz" (Flash) for rapid tasks and contemplative "Hakim" (Pro) for deep, complex reasoning and complex coding/math tasks.
featureSensoryIntelDesc: The Hub can see, understand, and generate. Analyze documents, create stunning images, edit photos, and even produce animated videos from simple text or image prompts.
featureMemoryCoreDesc: Engage in continuous, context-aware conversations. The Hub remembers your dialogue across all 120+ agents, providing a unified and intelligent experience without losing context.
featureRealWorldDesc: Connects seamlessly with live Google Search and Google Maps data, ensuring agents provide up-to-the-second, verifiable information and location-based insights for all your queries.
featureCulturalSoulDesc: Fine-tuned on Dari and Pashto, with a core identity deeply rooted in Afghan culture, rich history, and profound values. This ensures truly relevant, respectful, and nuanced interactions.
featureCostEffectiveDesc: Experience powerful, enterprise-grade AI performance at a near-zero operational cost, making advanced intelligence accessible to everyone without compromise.
agenticCoreTitle: The Agentic Core: Unleashing Intelligent Autonomy
agenticCoreDesc: At the heart of the AfghanAI Hub lies a sophisticated agentic system. This system empowers autonomous, goal-oriented AI entities that can perceive their environment, reason, plan, act, and learn. They leverage advanced tools and collaborate to solve complex problems, adapting dynamically to deliver precise solutions for myriad challenges.
agenticGoalDesc: Agents within the Hub operate independently, focusing on achieving specific objectives with minimal human intervention, from data analysis to content creation.
agenticToolDesc: Each agent is equipped to utilize a diverse array of internal and external tools, expanding its capabilities for complex tasks, including web searches and image manipulation.
agenticCollaborationDesc: Agents can interact and share information, forming ad-hoc networks to tackle multifaceted problems more effectively, simulating a team of experts.
agenticLearningDesc: The agentic core continuously learns from interactions and outcomes, refining its strategies and improving performance over time for enhanced precision.
modularityTitle: Unrivaled Modularity & Scalability: Your Customizable AI Ecosystem
modularityDesc: With over 120 specialized agents and the capacity for countless more, the AfghanAI Hub offers unparalleled modularity. Easily integrate, manage, and customize agents to form an AI ecosystem perfectly tailored to your unique requirements, from intricate governmental tasks to personalized educational journeys. The future of AI is tailored, and infinitely expandable.
modularityAgentsDesc: Explore a vast library of pre-built agents covering diverse domains from education to enterprise, ready to assist you instantly and intelligently.
modularityIntegrationDesc: Seamlessly add new agents or customize existing ones to perfectly match your evolving needs and objectives, making the Hub truly yours.
modularityManagementDesc: Manage all your agents from a single, intuitive interface, monitoring their performance, updating their roles, and ensuring optimal operation across the ecosystem.
modularityCustomizationDesc: Tailor agent behaviors, knowledge bases, and tool access to create a truly personalized AI ecosystem for any challenge, from micro-tasks to macro-strategies.
costTitle: Radical Cost-Effectiveness: Maximizing Value, Minimizing Spend
costDesc: The AfghanAI Hub is engineered from the ground up to deliver advanced AI capabilities at the lowest possible operational cost. Our "Radical Cost-Effectiveness Doctrine" is woven into every layer, ensuring high performance and accessibility without compromise.
costAllocationDesc: Leverages dynamic resource allocation to ensure computing power is consumed only when actively needed, minimizing costs and maximizing operational efficiency.
costCachingDesc: An advanced caching system stores frequently requested information, significantly reducing redundant processing and data retrieval costs.
costModelDesc: Automatically selects the most efficient AI model for each task (swift for quick queries, powerful for complex reasoning), ensuring optimal resource use and cost savings.
costToolUsageDesc: The system intelligently determines when and how to use external information sources, preventing unnecessary expenditures while maintaining accuracy.
missionDesc: The AfghanAI Hub is built on principles of sovereignty, ethical AI development, and radical cost-effectiveness. Our mission is to democratize advanced AI capabilities, making them accessible to every Afghan, fostering innovation, and contributing to a self-reliant and prosperous nation. We believe in technology that respects culture, empowers individuals, and drives collective progress.
founderQuote: We are not just building a tool; we are weaving a digital tapestry of our shared heritage, a bridge from our ancient past to a limitless future.
founderMsgP1: Welcome to the AfghanAI Hub. This project was born from a simple yet profound belief: that the immense intellectual and cultural wealth of our civilization should not be a relic of the past, but the very foundation of our future.
founderMsgP2: For generations, we have been the custodians of great poets, brilliant scientists, and profound thinkers. Today, we face a new frontier—the age of artificial intelligence. It is our duty, and our opportunity, to ensure that our values, our languages, and our stories are woven into the fabric of this new digital world.
founderMsgP3: The AfghanAI Hub is more than a platform; it is a digital House of Wisdom (Bayt al-Hikmah) for the 21st century. It is a place where a student in Herat can get help with her Kankor exams, a poet in Kandahar can find inspiration for a new ghazal, and an entrepreneur in Mazar-e-Sharif can build a business plan that respects our cultural context.
founderMsgP4: We built this with two core principles: 'Power Without Price' and 'Wisdom Without Weight'. By using a state-of-the-art, cost-optimized architecture, we can deliver this immense capability to everyone, on any device, without the heavy cost. It is a digital civilization that is accessible to all.
founderMsgP5: This is just the beginning. Join us in this renaissance. Let us build, learn, and dream together. Your journey starts now.
selectAgentPrompt: Select an agent from the list on the left to begin your interaction.
visionTitle: Our Vision for a Digital Renaissance
visionSubtitle: We are building more than just a tool; we are building a bridge between our ancient heritage and a limitless future. A digital 'House of Wisdom' for the 21st century.
visionQuote: From scattered data, a universe of knowledge.
techTitle: Built on a Modern, Scalable Foundation
techSubtitle: Leveraging the best of modern web and AI technology to deliver a seamless, powerful, and cost-effective experience.
techNextJsDesc: The latest in React and server components for a fast, interactive, and dynamic user interface.
techGenkitDesc: An open-source AI framework for building robust, production-ready AI flows and agents.
techFirebaseDesc: A powerful backend for real-time data, authentication, and secure, scalable cloud infrastructure.
principlesSubtitle: This project is built on a foundation of trust, respect, and a commitment to our shared values.
principlePrivacyDesc: Your data is yours alone. We believe in absolute data privacy. Your conversations are not used for training models.
principleCultureDesc: All our agents are designed to understand and respect Afghan cultural norms, languages, and values.
principleAccessibilityDesc: Our architecture is optimized for performance, ensuring the Hub is accessible even on low-bandwidth connections.
communityTitle: For the Community, By the Community
communitySubtitle: The AfghanAI Hub is a non-commercial project dedicated to the preservation and promotion of our shared knowledge. It is, and always will be, free to use.
faq1q: Is the AfghanAI Hub free to use?
faq1a: Yes, a generous free tier is available. This is a community-focused project. Advanced features are available for Pro users.
faq2a: The Hub is designed to be fluent in Dari and Pashto, in addition to English. Our AI agents will respond in the language of your prompt.
faq3a: Absolutely. Your conversations are yours alone. We do not use your data for training AI models, and anonymous users' data is cleared regularly.
faq4q: What technology is this built on?
faq4a: AfghanAI is a sophisticated synthesis, fine-tuned from the world's leading foundational models, including Anthropic, OpenAI, and Gemini. This allows us to create a unique, powerful, and culturally-aligned AI ecosystem, all orchestrated by Google's Genkit on a secure Firebase backend.
faq5a: This platform was conceived and built by a single founder, forged through a period of intense, solitary effort. It stands as a testament to the idea that a singular vision, when pursued relentlessly, can make the impossible possible. The story is one of determination against all odds.
faq6q: What is the vision for AfghanAI?
faq6a: Our vision is to spark a digital renaissance. We aim to create a sovereign AI ecosystem that not only preserves our rich intellectual and cultural heritage but also empowers a new generation of thinkers, creators, and builders. It is a 'House of Wisdom' for the 21st century.
footerAboutText: A sovereign, living intelligence designed to preserve our past and build our future. Our digital renaissance starts now.
